concept: Focusing on what you can control instead of what you can't
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Stoic control-focused tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character is upset about something they can't change (like the weather ruining a plan) and finds something they CAN do about it
exercise.reflection_prompt: What could the character control, even though they couldn't control everything?
exercise.practice: Student sorts a few example problems into 'things I can control' and 'things I can't'

assessment.success_marker: student correctly sorts at least 3 of 4 example problems
